sentences.text: Date : 22/04/2018  ORAL ORDER
This Criminal Revision Application is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat, today.
Learned APP Shri JK Shah appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has produced Withdrawal/Settlement pursis, which is taken on record.

The said pursis is duly signed by authorized person Shri C.S. Gohil, who is identified by Shri D.R. Sharma, Law Officer of the Food and Drugs Control Department, who is present before this Court, stating that he has no objection if the matter is disposed as per the prevailing policy.
All the concerned parties have put their signatures of the said withdrawal pursis.

As such, on going through the record, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the original accused-revisionist under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not R/CR.RA/139/2014 ORDER serious in nature and the punishment or penalty for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, it is Bharatbhai Govindbhai Patel vs Kalyanbhai Chhotubhai Kumbi on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126629160/
1 compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.

sentences.text:
It is pointed out that by virtue of an Order dated 10th February 2014 passed by this Court, pending hearing and final disposal of the present Criminal Revision Application, the execution,
implementation and operation of the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 31st January 2014 passed by the learned 2nd Additional District Judge (I/c.) Navsari in Criminal Appeal No. 36 of 2006, confirming the judgment and order dated 25th July 2006 passed by the learned Senior Civil Judge and J.M.F.C., Navsari in Criminal Case No. 7136 of 1996 has been suspended.
In view of pursis of the parties, the present Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of.

The applicant/revisionist is hereby directed to pay fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only] before the High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad within a period of four weeks of this Order; as agreed, failing which the Criminal Revision Application shall stand revived automatically.

R/CR.RA/139/2014 ORDER confirming the judgment and order dated 25th July 2006 passed by the learned Senior Civil Judge and J.M.F.C., Navsari in Criminal Case No. 7136 of 1996 stands modified by converting the same into fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only].
Bail bonds; if any, stand cancelled.
R&P; if any, be transmitted back to the trial Court.
